{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending), then drop duplicates
df_dedup = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

print("Deduplicated data shape:", df_dedup.shape)
print("Number of unique patients after deduplication:", df_dedup['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Re-test count after deduplication:", len(df) - len(df_dedup))

# Exclude rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
# Create a mask for valid baseline values
valid_baseline = df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] != -999

# Apply the filter
df_filtered = df_dedup[valid_baseline].copy()

print("Number of rows after excluding -999 in baseline:", len(df_filtered))
print("Number of patients remaining:", df_filtered['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check the treatment arm
print("Treatment arm distribution after filtering:")
print(df_filtered['arm'].value_counts())

# Now extract treatment arm only
df_treatment = df_filtered[df_filtered['arm'] == 'treatment']

print("Treatment arm after deduplication and filtering:")
print(df_treatment.shape)
print("Number of patients in treatment arm:", df_treatment['patient_id'].nunique())"}
